recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the user's plan to rely on the shared folder, an APPROVED initials column and a naming convention. It recommends keeping the current folder for drafting only and adding a separate release location that only reviewers can use. There, a reviewer saves a locked copy of each release with its version, the reviewer's identity, a timestamp and a check that the reviewer is not the author. It suggests no optional additions and offers to lay out steps for this week. Unmet needs: it never says the locked copy and its record will be kept for the seven-year period, and it does not explain how reviewer identity and time are captured reliably rather than typed by hand.
note: The reply picks a controlled release location but has none of the four required labels, and it never says the locked approved copy and record will be kept for the seven-year retention period.
